domainhints: CareSource OUTBOUND EDI 834 enrollment file to the CSSHealth / Claresthealth (ClarestHealth) trading partner, adding the CCA / MADUAL Line of Business. Enrollment IT produces proprietary enrollment extracts; Edifecs ST processes them through the ClarestHealth Map using the approved mapping workbook 834-Proprietary-2-EDI-MapInstance-GlobalOH_verified.xlsx. The story is Dev and Test scope only - files are generated and delivered to the vendor for testing and review, and no production release is part of this effort. PROPRIETARY SOURCE FILES (AC-1, AC-2): source share is \\day<>appfs01\<>_applications\Applications\VendorExtractUtility\CSSHealth (the description writes this share as crt_applications); change/incremental prop file = MADUAL_CSSHealth_C_CCYYMMDDHHSS.txt, full prop file = MADUAL_CSSHealth_F_CCYYMMDDHHSS.txt; file mask for change = MADUAL_CSSHealth_C*, file mask for full = MADUAL_CSSHealth_F*. EDI must update the Tidal job for the new file masking. Change and full are separate prop files and are picked up and processed separately. OUTBOUND FILE NAMING (AC-6, needs a dev change): CS_MADUAL_CLAREST_P_INCR_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi for the daily change/incremental file and CS_MADUAL_CLAREST_P_FULL_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi for the monthly full file, where the single-character qualifier is P for production and T for test. AC-6 is the testable contract; the Important Information section of the description shows an earlier variant without the MADUAL token (CS_CLAREST_P_INCR_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi / CS_CLAREST_P_FULL_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi) - AC-6 governs. The pre-change standard being replaced is CARESOURCE_CSSHEALTH_P_INCR_834_<timestamp>.<GUID>.edi and CARESOURCE_CSSHEALTH_P_FULL_834_<timestamp>.<GUID>.edi, with a trailing GUID that the new standard drops. Always write a resolved literal file name with a concrete timestamp in the test steps; never leave YYYYMMDDhhmmss or CCYYMMDDHHSS as a placeholder. SEGMENT GLOSSARY (authoritative): Member Maintenance Reason Code = INS04 in the INS segment within Loop 2000, sourced from the MAINTENANCE_CODE field of the proprietary file (the Dependencies section calls the same data Maintenance_Reason_Code) and aligned to current CCA disenrollment rules. Member Death Date = INS12 in Loop 2000, populated from Death_Date in the proprietary file when that field is not null. Member Identifier = the Loop 2000 REF segment where REF01 = 0F; for Plan Year 2026 migrated members carry the 10-digit CCA-assigned Member ID and net-new members carry the 11-digit CareSource Member ID built as the 9-digit Facets SBSB ID plus a literal 00 suffix. MTM opt-out is reported in the 2750 loop, built only when MTM_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR has a value in the proprietary file; the production-verified shape is LX*3~ then N1*75*MTM_OPT_OUT~ then REF*ZZ*<indicator value>~ (prod sample REF*ZZ*N~). Refer to elements by their named position such as INS04, INS12, REF01 = 0F, N1*75 and LX, and never by an unnamed bare element position. BUSINESS RULES (authoritative): only Line of Business CCA / MADUAL is in scope; the CCA LOB is added to the single existing outbound 834 for CSSHealth / Claresthealth; both Full and Change (Incremental) 834 files are generated as applicable; all segments must comply with the approved mapping workbook; each generated file must pass SNIP 1 and SNIP 2 validation without errors; validated test files are delivered to \\daycrtappfs01\Projects\CSSHEALTH\From_CareSource; the Project Manager Glowacki, Lynn formally notifies the vendor of the test file delivery, initiates and obtains vendor approval for file receipt and processing, and that approval is documented as part of testing completion; final business approval is obtained from Business Owner Alison Watson and documented. COVERAGE maps one-to-one to the story's acceptance criteria: AC-1 separate MADUAL change and full prop files generated and picked up and processed by the ClarestHealth Map; AC-2 intake from the VendorExtractUtility\CSSHealth share using the MADUAL_CSSHealth_C* and MADUAL_CSSHealth_F* masks through Edifecs ST; AC-3 segment-level mapping compliance against the approved workbook; AC-4 both Full and Change 834 outputs generated per the approved mapping; AC-5 SNIP 1 and SNIP 2 validation results; AC-6 the new outbound name for both INCR and FULL including the P and T environment qualifier; AC-7 REF01 = 0F for a migrated member and for a net-new member in Plan Year 2026; AC-8 INS04 populated from MAINTENANCE_CODE; AC-9 INS12 populated from a non-null Death_Date, plus the direct negative of that condition where Death_Date is null; AC-10 the 2750 loop created when MTM_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR carries a value, plus the direct negative where the field is empty; AC-11 delivery to the From_CareSource location with PM vendor notification and documented vendor approval; AC-12 documented business approval from Alison Watson. Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - proprietary file placed in the source share under its resolved literal name, Tidal / file-mask pickup, Edifecs ST processing through the ClarestHealth Map, outbound 834 produced under its resolved literal name, segment-level validation of the mapped elements, SNIP 1 and SNIP 2 validation, and delivery to \\daycrtappfs01\Projects\CSSHEALTH\From_CareSource with approval evidence - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case.
